 La Bodega Live 
 La Bodega Live 2027 announces Siloé: 26 June at the Bodegas Franco-Españolas in Logroño, with tickets at €60.50
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Lucas Moreno 
 13 Nov 2026, 14:00 
 A 3-minute read 
 Pedro J Pacheco / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Siloé is the first name for La Bodega Live 2027 , which takes place on Saturday 26 June at the Bodegas Franco-Españolas in Logroño, and the festival says more artists will follow. 
 General admission is now on sale at €60.50 including fees , after the €55 launch offer sold out. 
 It is a one-day festival among gardens, vineyards and barrels , and its 2026 debut sold out 4,500 tickets before the gates opened, according to the La Rioja press. 
 For Siloé it is a stop between BigSound and FIB , in a summer 2027 in which the band already has several festivals with passes on sale. 
 Siloé opens the line-up for the second edition of La Bodega Live , the festival that debuted in 2026 in the gardens of the Bodegas Franco-Españolas in Logroño . The event is on Saturday 26 June 2027 , and general admission tickets are already on sale even though, for now, the Valladolid band is the only confirmed name.
 Festival guide 
 La Bodega Live 2027 
 26 Jun 2027 · Bodegas Franco-Españolas, Logroño 
 Tickets 
 Disponibles 
 Siloé, first name for the second edition
 The festival's official website presents Siloé (Fito Robles, Xavi Road and Jaco Betanzos) as its first confirmation and adds that there will be more artists to be confirmed . The band will come to Logroño on the tour for ‘Terrorismo emocional’ , the album it released in May 2026.
 According to CrazyMinds and Actualidad Rioja Baja, the festival is organised by Promociones Iregua together with the winery itself . Actualidad Rioja Baja adds that the rest of the line-up will be announced in the coming weeks.
 Tickets: €60.50 with only one name on the line-up
 Tickets are on sale in the official La Bodega Live shop , run by Eventim Paylogic. The launch offer , a limited number of tickets at €55 including fees, is now shown as sold out . What is on sale now is first-tier general admission , at €60.50 , of which €5.50 is booking fees. The shop does not say when this tier ends or how much the next one will cost.
 The ticket is valid for the whole day: gates open at 19:00 and the programme starts at 20:00 . Children aged up to 10 get in free , according to the shop's policy on minors.
 Anyone buying now is doing so for Siloé and the festival's format, without knowing the rest of the line-up.
 Siloé at Brisa Festival 2025. Image: Pedro J Pacheco / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) A one-day festival among vineyards and barrels
 La Bodega Live takes place in the gardens and vineyards of the Bodegas Franco-Españolas , at calle Cabo Noval, 2, in Logroño. The festival talks about century-old barrels and glasses of wine as part of the experience.
 The first edition was on 27 June 2026 , with Shinova , Gara Durán , Ultraligera and Sao. According to CrazyMinds and Actualidad Rioja Baja, it sold out its 4,500 tickets before the gates opened. Actualidad Rioja Baja reports that the day also included DJ sets, a wine bar and a tour of the winery.
 It is not the only Logroño festival in our listings: there is also Actual , from 2 to 6 January, and MUWI , which in 2027 will run from 15 to 18 July. La Bodega Live takes the end of June, almost three weeks before MUWI. The date, times, venue and tickets for this edition are also on the La Bodega Live page .
 Where else to see Siloé in summer 2027
 The La Rioja stop fits into a summer in which Siloé already appears on several line-ups with confirmed dates. In order:
 12 June: Córdoba Live , a concert series with tickets sold per night.
 18 and 19 June: BigSound Valencia , in Torrent.
 26 June: La Bodega Live, in Logroño.
 15 to 17 July: FIB , in Benicàssim.
 30 July to 1 August: Low Festival , in Torrevieja.
 Our round-up of where to see Siloé in 2027 has the passes and prices for each festival, and the rest of that month's events are in the June festival listings .
 Sources: official La Bodega Live website and its ticket shop, consulted on 13 November 2026; CrazyMinds and Actualidad Rioja Baja, 12 November 2026; La Ganzúa, 30 September 2026.
